title: collapsible laundry basket
text: collapsible laundry basket. This is a super great laundry and/or storage basket!  The collapsible part for storage is key.  It does take quiet a bit of strength to open it the first few times - but - work it a few times, it'll come. Even though it folds it is very sturdy.  It is vented in several places. It is white- ish and gray in color.  I expect it will work perfectly for my needs.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new inf seem useful.
